title: Rabbi Achai bar Chanina (a Tanna of a Baraita)
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Shabbat 79b and Menachot 32a, where Rabbi Acha speaks in his name. In Berakhot 2b: Rabbi Achai, and some say Rabbi Acha.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Davidson Shabbat 79b page includes Rabbi Acha reporting in the name of Rabbi Achay bar Chanina, followed by an alternative attribution to Rabbi Yaakov beRabbi Chanina. The first father is untitled; the second father’s full title is not transferred to him. The whole selected Berakhot 2b paragraph separately has Rabbi Achai, or some say Rabbi Acha. The whole Menachot 32a page was read without the named Achai report, a bounded nonmatch only. The supplied Achai spelling, locators, alternative and untitled Chanina remain; no identity merger is inferred.
